verdict.rationale: YPOG's own transactions page says it regularly advises on "the largest German equity financing rounds" and markets itself "from inception to exit", and its seedstrapping briefing addresses when a priced equity round fits. That supports a venture financing practice covering equity rounds, likely across stages. However, the site's representative matters (Langdock seat relocation, Isembard market entry) are not financing rounds, and no deal volume is stated. missing for 10: stated deal volume or counts, named representative priced-round transactions on its pages, explicit seed-through-late-stage round coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm's venture financing practice covers priced equity rounds from seed through late stage, with stated deal volume or representative transactions on its own pages

citations.quote: Our transaction experts regularly provide advice and support on the largest German equity financing rounds, venture debt and high-profile exit transactions
Well advised from inception to exit.
